current_formulation: From room version 4, the event ID is the reference hash of the event in URL-safe unpadded Base64.

steps.formulation: Room versions 1 and 2 give an event an opaque ID with a domain that only namespaces it.
steps.quote: Event IDs in this room version have the format: $opaque_id:domain

criticism.quote: servers receive multiple events with the same ID in either the same or different rooms where the server cannot easily keep track of which event it should be using.

steps.formulation: Room version 3 computes the event ID as the reference hash of the event in unpadded Base64.
steps.quote: The event ID is the reference hash of the event encoded using Unpadded Base64, prefixed with $.

criticism.quote: Room version 3 generated event IDs that were difficult for client implementations which were not encoding the event ID to function in those rooms.

steps.formulation: Room version 4 replaces the 62nd and 63rd Base64 characters with URL-safe ones.
steps.quote: a variation of Unpadded Base64 which replaces the 62nd and 63rd characters with - and _ instead of using + and /.
